facts.fact: The Permanent Secretary at the communication and digital economy ministry says the government has formulated and adopted a National Cybersecurity Policy & Strategy.
The Permanent Secretary says the Cybercrime Bill is in the process of being enacted into law.
The Permanent Secretary says the Data Protection Bill is in the process of being enacted into law, with no stage before parliament given.

GMB.note: The document states no rural programme or rural and urban survey figures.

facts.fact: The Permanent Secretary says the ACE submarine cable landed in The Gambia in 2012; a second cable is funded but expected only by the end of 2025.

GMB.note: The 150 per cent figure is a subscription rate, not a share of people owning a phone.

facts.fact: PURA, The Gambia's regulator and a member of WATRA, hosted the WATRA working groups meeting in Banjul on 10 to 13 June 2024.
